_comment: Copy to config.json (install.ps1 does this for you). Paths are machine-specific; config.json is git-ignored.
_extraVoicesDirs: Extra folders searched for voices, same <sex>/<culture>/<id> layout. For voices you may keep but not publish -- they stay out of this repo entirely.
_watch: Follow session transcripts directly rather than waiting for Claude Code to call the hooks. Works in any client, no restart. Turn off to rely on hooks alone.
_historyKeep: How many past utterances keep their audio, so the panel can replay one instantly. They live in %TEMP% and are cleared when the engine restarts.
